thread:
maya: Quick sync 1: need two hero charts + three microcopy variants for the benchmark landing and webinar. Can design start if we lock visuals today?

jon: Use placeholders for exact numbers (<P95_MS>, <COST_PER_1K>). I'll drop a provisional CSV by 10:30 for design to mock.

sergio: Draft chart ideas: 1) Routing waterfall (percent served by cheaper variants + p95 bands) as hero, 2) Cost-per-1k stacked bars by model+quant, 3) Latency curve with throughput overlay for ops.

maya: Good. Hero should tell the routing story without heavy numbers. Deck will show cost bars.

elaine: Copy needs: three hero lines (short), two CTAs (chart vs demo), and an SDR one-liner + rebuttal for "we host ourselves."

katie: Social snippets: very short, e.g. "Lower per-token spend. Keep latency steady." Avoid hard multipliers until numbers validated.

jon: CSV columns to include: model, variant, quant, workload, p50_ms, p95_ms, throughput_tps, cost_per_1k, tokens_per_req, notes. Will confirm hardware in the CSV.

sergio: Design notes: Redwood green for positive, muted gray baseline, p95 callouts, tiny footnote "results vary by workload" and a one-line methodology blurb.

maya: Draft hero lines:
- "Same outputs. Lower cost."
- "Predictable latency. Better unit economics."
- "Cut inference spend without app changes."

elaine: I prefer the first for clarity. Short works best for signup flow.

maya: SDR one-liner: "We route requests to cost-friendly variants while keeping your latency SLOs 1 no code changes." Rebuttal: "Totally 1 we can overlay a trace and show a tailored cost chart in 10 minutes."

katie: CTA A: "Get a quick cost chart"; CTA B: "See a benchmark for your app". A/B test both. Also add a small form field: average request size (tokens).

jon: I'll post the provisional numbers here when ready. Please don't lock copy with numeric claims until I confirm.

maya: Timeline: charts and microcopy locked today -> design starts tomorrow morning. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
